context: A class wrap-up on duty and conviction
purpose: Teach: 兵士/軍隊/脅威/行使/条例/判定/使命/信者

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日の授業では、若い兵士たちが何のために戦ったのか、みんなで考えましたね。
lines.en: In today's lesson, we all thought together about what young soldiers were fighting for.
lines.style: Calm closing tone, measured and reflective, addressing the class warmly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 正直、軍隊に所属して命令を受ける生活って、どんな気持ちなのか想像もつかなくて。
lines.en: Honestly, I can't imagine what it feels like to belong to a military and live under orders.
lines.style: Hesitant teenage voice, thoughtful and a little uncertain, trailing off softly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうよね。差し迫る脅威を前に、武力を行使するかどうかは、本当に難しい問題なの。
lines.en: Right. When facing an imminent threat, whether to use military force is a truly difficult question.
lines.style: Gentle teacher voice, softly agreeing, drawing the student into deeper thought.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 市の条例で平和教育が決まってるって聞くと、答えが先に判定されてる気がしちゃうんです。
lines.en: When I hear the city ordinance mandates peace education, it feels like the answer is judged in advance.
lines.style: Mildly critical teen, voicing a small complaint with rising intonation at the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その違和感も大切よ。でも先生には、考える機会を渡すという重要な使命があると思っているの。
lines.en: That discomfort matters too. But I believe teachers have an important mission to hand students the chance to think.
lines.style: Warm conviction, steady delivery, slightly maternal in cadence and pacing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 信者みたいに何も疑わず受け入れるのは怖いけど、先生の問いかけは聞きたいって思います。
lines.en: Accepting things without doubt like a believer scares me, but I want to hear your questions.
lines.style: Softening tone, sincere admission, slight smile audible in the voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ありがとう。疑いながら聞いてくれるのが、先生には一番うれしいことなのよ。
lines.en: Thank you. Listening while still questioning is what makes me happiest of all.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude, ending the lesson on a tender, encouraging note.
